    B

    be.imgn.json - module be.imgn.json
    A fast, strict JSON parser and writer: a streaming API, an immutable tree, and binding to records through generated code.
    be.imgn.json - package be.imgn.json
    Parsing and writing JSON: the parser and the writer, the documents and their immutable tree of values, and the errors.
    be.imgn.json.bind - package be.imgn.json.bind
    The annotations that bind records to JSON, through code that the annotation processor of be.imgn.json:json-processor generates: JsonRecord and the annotations that tune it.
    be.imgn.json.processor - module be.imgn.json.processor
    The annotation processor that generates the binders of the types annotated be.imgn.json.bind.JsonRecord.
    be.imgn.json.spi - package be.imgn.json.spi
    What the code generated for records implements and calls: not meant to be used directly.
    be.imgn.json.stream - package be.imgn.json.stream
    Reading and writing JSON value by value, without a tree: JsonStreamReader over a parsed document, JsonStreamWriter to an output.

    J

    JSON - Enum constant in enum class be.imgn.json.JsonFormat
    RFC 8259 JSON, the default.
    JSON5 - Enum constant in enum class be.imgn.json.JsonFormat
    JSON5 1.0.0: JSON with comments; trailing commas; names written as ECMAScript 5.1 identifiers; strings in single quotes, with more escape sequences and lines continued by a backslash; hexadecimal numbers, numbers with a leading or trailing decimal point or a plus sign, NaN and the infinities; and more white space, a leading byte order mark included.
    JsonArray - Class in be.imgn.json
    A JSON array: values, in order.
    JsonBinder<T> - Interface in be.imgn.json.spi
    Reads a type from a stream and writes it to one.
    JsonBindings - Class in be.imgn.json.spi
    Reads the values that the code generated for JsonRecord types binds from strings, and checks the type of a JsonValue.
    JsonBoolean - Enum Class in be.imgn.json
    A JSON boolean.
    JSONC - Enum constant in enum class be.imgn.json.JsonFormat
    JSONC: JSON with // and /* */ comments wherever JSON has whitespace.
    JsonDocument - Class in be.imgn.json
    A parsed document: its root value, and where each of its values is written.
    JsonException - Exception Class in be.imgn.json
    Thrown when a document cannot be read: it is not valid in the format of the parser, or it does not bind to the type it is read as.
    JsonFormat - Enum Class in be.imgn.json
    The syntax a JsonParser reads, each strictly: a document is rejected as soon as it steps outside its format.
    JsonMappingException - Exception Class in be.imgn.json
    Thrown when a valid document does not bind to the type it is read as: a value of the wrong type, a number out of range, a missing or unknown member, or a value the type rejects.
    JsonName - Annotation Interface in be.imgn.json.bind
    Gives the name of a record component's member, the string of an enum constant, or the tag that names a record in a sealed interface, in place of its Java name.
    JsonNames - Class in be.imgn.json.stream
    Member names known in advance, for JsonStreamReader.name(JsonNames) to match without creating a String, and for JsonStreamWriter.name(JsonNames, int) to write already encoded.
    JsonNull - Enum Class in be.imgn.json
    The JSON null.
    JsonNumber - Class in be.imgn.json
    A JSON number, kept exactly as written: it is converted only when one of the as methods is called.
    JsonObject - Class in be.imgn.json
    A JSON object: members with distinct names, in the order of the document or of their insertion.
    JsonObject.Builder - Class in be.imgn.json
    Builds an object, keeping the order of the members.
    JsonParseException - Exception Class in be.imgn.json
    Thrown when a document is not valid in the format of the parser, or exceeds a limit of the parser.
    JsonParser - Class in be.imgn.json
    Parses RFC 8259 JSON strictly: a document that is not valid JSON, has an object with two members of the same name, or exceeds a limit, is rejected with a JsonParseException.
    JsonParser() - Constructor for class be.imgn.json.JsonParser
    Creates a parser with the default settings: see JsonParser.Builder.
    JsonParser.Builder - Class in be.imgn.json
    Builds a parser.
    JsonPosition - Record Class in be.imgn.json
